import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from h2 import *
T=[]
W_OK = ('MESSAGE sip:b@y.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: <sip:a@x.test>;tag=t1\r\nTo: <sip:b@y.test>\r\n'
        'Call-ID: c1\r\nCSeq: 1 MESSAGE\r\nPrivacy: none\r\nP-Asserted-Identity: <sip:a@x.test>\r\n'
        'Content-Length: 2\r\n\r\nhi')
j0 = job(req(), gateway='edge', kind='local', subject='s1', trusted=True)
# trusted_out false but privacy inactive -> PAI still emitted
j1b = job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', trusted=False, source=0)
T.append(('hop2 trusted_out false emits PAI', [j0,j1b], {'status':'accept','identity':'sip:a@x.test','basis':'peer','private':False,'wire':W_OK}))
# peer hop privacy true trusted_out true -> PAI emitted
j0p = job(req({'Privacy':'id'}), gateway='edge', kind='local', subject='s1', trusted=True)
j1p = job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', trusted=True, source=0)
T.append(('peer privacy hop emits PAI', [j0p,j1p], {'status':'accept','identity':'sip:a@x.test','basis':'peer','private':True,
 'wire':'MESSAGE sip:b@y.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=t1\r\nTo: <sip:b@y.test>\r\nCall-ID: c1\r\nCSeq: 1 MESSAGE\r\nPrivacy: id\r\nP-Asserted-Identity: <sip:a@x.test>\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\n\r\nhi'}))
# source references
T.append(('future source', [job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', source=1), j0], rj('upstream')))
T.append(('bad source index', [job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', source=5), j0], rj('upstream')))
T.append(('bool source', [job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', source=True), j0], rj('upstream')))
T.append(('hop unknown peer authority', [j0, job(None, gateway='far', kind='peer', peer='ghost', trusted=True, source=0)], rj('identity')))
# length boundary
body_len = 32768 - 130
T.append(('raw exactly 32768', [job(req(body='x'*body_len))], {'status':'accept','identity':'sip:a@x.test','basis':'local','private':False}))
T.append(('raw 32769', [job(req(body='x'*(body_len+1)))], rj('syntax')))
# forwarded wire that grew past 32768 -> syntax at the next hop
T.append(('grew wire', [job(req(body='x'*body_len)), job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', source=0)], rj('syntax')))
# a forwarded wire that stays under the limit
small_len = 32768 - 130 - 60
T.append(('wire under limit', [job(req(body='x'*small_len)), job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', source=0)],
          {'status':'accept','identity':'sip:a@x.test','basis':'peer','private':False}))
for name, jobs, want in T:
    got = run(batch(jobs))['results'][-1]
    check(name, got, want)
# forward/source results individually
res = run(batch([job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', source=1), j0]))['results']
print('future-source pair:', res[0], '| idx1 accepted:', res[1]['status'])
print('FAILS:', FAILS)
PYEOF
python3 t5b.py 2>&1 | grep -v '^ok'
